figurative_meaning_en: A mixture of songs from various genres
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে পাঁচমিশালী গান বাজছে, সবাই উপভোগ করছে।
এই অ্যালবামে পাঁচমিশালী গানের সংকলন আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A medley of songs was playing at the party, and everyone was enjoying it.
This album features a potpourri of songs from different genres.
note: The term 'পাঁচমিশালী' draws from the Bengali culinary concept of mixed vegetables, metaphorically applied to diverse song collections.
